description: This file defines the Git::Packet Perl module, providing functions for reading, writing, and managing Git protocol packets, including capabilities exchange and packet comparison.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN.

methods.name: remove_final_lf_or_die
methods.description: Removes trailing LF from a buffer or dies if not present.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, handling binary packet reading.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a key=value text packet and verifies the key.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet with a trailing LF.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Initializes a packet exchange with given name and version.

methods.name: packet_read_and_check_capabilities
methods.description: Reads remote capabilities and checks against required.

methods.name: packet_check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Checks local capabilities against remote and advertises them.
